prompt.en: The two walls look alike, but they are not. Find what is different.
prompt.ar: الجِدَارَانِ يَبْدُوَانِ مُتَشَابِهَيْن، لَكِنَّهُمَا لَيْسَا كَذَلِك. جِدِ الفَرْق.

hint1.en: Look at the creatures — are all of them in the same place?
hint1.ar: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى الكَائِنَات؛ هَلْ كُلُّهَا فِي نَفْسِ المَكَان؟

hint2.en: Something on this side is missing from the other.
hint2.ar: شَيْءٌ مَا هُنَا غَائِبٌ مِنَ الجَانِبِ الآخَر.

model.en: There. That is the difference. Now look for the next one.
model.ar: هُنَاك. ذَاكَ هُوَ الفَرْق. الآنَ ابْحَثْ عَنِ التَّالِي.

success.en: You found every difference. The page must be behind this wall.
success.ar: وَجَدْتَ كُلَّ الفُرُوق. لَا بُدَّ أَنَّ الصَّفْحَةَ خَلْفَ هَذَا الجِدَار.

payload._comment: Two sections of the same trench wall, lit by Sadaf's glow-weed. Three creatures are displaced between the panels — a crab that moved left, a shell missing from one side, and a small fish behind a rock on one side only. These are not random: the shell's absence is a plot clue (it is the one holding the page), so finding it is what makes the reveal meaningful rather than arbitrary.

revealLine.en: The crab is on the other side! Crabs move when something disturbs them.
revealLine.ar: السَّرَطَانُ فِي الجِهَةِ الأُخْرَى! السَّرَطَانَاتُ تَتَحَرَّكُ حِينَ يُزْعِجُهَا شَيْء.

revealLine.en: That shell is gone from the right wall. Something took it — or it fell behind.
revealLine.ar: اِخْتَفَتِ الصَّدَفَةُ مِنَ الجِدَارِ الأَيْمَن. شَيْءٌ مَا أَخَذَهَا، أَوِ انْزَلَقَتْ إِلَى الخَلْف.

revealLine.en: A small fish is hiding on the left wall but not on the right. It has been watching.
revealLine.ar: سَمَكَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ تَخْتَبِئُ فِي الجِدَارِ الأَيْسَرِ وَلَيْسَ فِي الأَيْمَن. كَانَتْ تُرَاقِب.
